name: Open Targets Platform
scope: Integrated target-disease evidence. The 26.09 output has 61 datasets, including: credible_set, study, variant, colocalisation, l2g_prediction, enhancer_to_gene, baseline_expression, interaction, target_essentiality (DepMap), evidence_crispr/evidence_crispr_screen, evidence_impc, evidence_clingen, evidence_eva (ClinVar), evidence_gwas_credible_sets, evidence_gene_burden, evidence_genomics_england, evidence_uniprot_variants, pharmacogenomics, mouse_phenotype and reactome. The variant dataset states that all variation is mapped to GRCh38 with 1-based gnomAD-style identifiers (chrom_pos_ref_alt) and population allele frequencies from gnomAD 4.1. The acquired credible_set dataset holds 4,761,925 credible-set rows (eQTL 1,718,748; GWAS 1,519,507; sQTL 844,764; transcript-usage QTL 521,558; single-cell eQTL 123,630; pQTL 33,718), fine-mapped by SuSiE (3,231,045), SuSiE-inf (771,560) or PICS (759,320), with beta, z-score, standard error, p-value and effect-allele frequency per variant; the study dataset describes 3,004,247 studies from 47 projects.
mapping_methods: Evidence is mapped to Ensembl targets and EFO diseases by Open Targets pipelines; variant-level datasets keyed by GRCh38 coordinates (assembly not confirmed from the live evidence).

quantitative.summary: Association scores, credible-set posterior probabilities, colocalisation statistics, locus-to-gene scores, essentiality scores.
quantitative.uncertainty: credible-set PIPs and coloc posteriors where provided

reuse_decision.rationale: Already integrates GWAS credible sets, colocalisation, DepMap, CRISPR screens, IMPC, ClinGen, ClinVar (EVA) and pharmacogenomics. Use it as the primary route for those dimensions instead of scraping each source; keep the originals only where Open Targets omits information.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Integrated target-disease evidence. The target-disease association is gene-level; variant-level datasets (credible sets, colocalisation, evidence from ClinVar and UniProt) are allele-specific but remain those of the originating source, whose profile governs.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Aggregated, with the evidence kind of each part retained: association statistics, curated assertions, perturbation results and predictions. Overall association scores combine datasets with fixed weights and are ranking aids, not evidence strength.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Inherited from the originating dataset and generally low for allele-level mechanism: gene-level scores say nothing about a specific allele, and a locus-to-gene prediction is a hypothesis about the target gene.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Disease and phenotype associations of genes and loci, ontology-mapped; each part carries the phenotype semantics of its source.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A target without evidence for a disease has no integrated evidence in this release, which reflects what the integrated sources cover and not the absence of a relationship.
